summary: Grandpa finished the story of running off to the fair in Prague in 1958: he and Pepa rode part of the way by tram without tickets, then walked, with no money, and came back in the middle of the night. His dad was waiting in the doorway with a belt, and Pepa was grounded for the whole summer holidays. Pepa later married Grandpa's sister Vera. Then Grandpa moved on to his military service in Jihlava from 1965, which he promised to tell properly next time.
